installCommand: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends openssh-server && apt-get clean
serveCommand: mkdir -p /run/sshd && exec /usr/sbin/sshd -D -e -p {{port}} {{listen}} -o AuthorizedKeysFile={{keysFile}} -o PasswordAuthentication=no -o KbdInteractiveAuthentication=no -o PermitRootLogin=prohibit-password -o StrictModes=no

tailscale.installCommand: . /etc/os-release && install -d -m 0755 /usr/share/keyrings && curl -fsSL "https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/ubuntu/$VERSION_CODENAME.noarmor.gpg" -o /usr/share/keyrings/tailscale-archive-keyring.gpg && curl -fsSL "https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/ubuntu/$VERSION_CODENAME.tailscale-keyring.list" -o /etc/apt/sources.list.d/tailscale.list && apt-get update -q -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/tailscale.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o APT::Get::List-Cleanup=0 && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends tailscale && apt-get clean
tailscale.removeCommand: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get purge -y -q tailscale && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get autoremove -y -q && rm -rf /etc/apt/sources.list.d/tailscale.list /usr/share/keyrings/tailscale-archive-keyring.gpg /var/lib/tailscale /run/tailscale
